page: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. It features 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. The CPU includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations. This instance operates on the Nitro hypervisor and does not include local instance storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results show strong performance across memory-intensive and computational workloads. The server achieves a strong read-only memory bandwidth of 3839.06 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 192.76 GB/sec for larger uncached blocks. Single-threaded gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression both register strong results, with the latter reaching 333.56 GB/sec. In Geekbench testing, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in image and text processing, alongside strong scores in software compilation and ray tracing. For database operations, the server handles 87.47 million Redis SET operations per second and scores strongly in Passmark database benchmarks.

From a resource density perspective, the r8i-flex.12xlarge offers a highly efficient memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8:1, making it a cost-effective choice for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The inclusion of AMX instructions enables efficient CPU-based machine learning tasks, as evidenced by strong LLM inference speeds, such as 259.26 tokens/sec for prompt processing on a 7B model. This server is highly suited for large-scale database deployments, in-memory caching, enterprise software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
description: Amazon Web Services r8i-flex.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server designed for resource-intensive workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz, it delivers 48 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of high-speed 7 GHz DDR5 memory. The architecture features a large 480 MB L3 cache and supports Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512. Operating on the Nitro hypervisor, the instance lacks local storage and GPUs but provides an 11 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks indicate strong memory bandwidth, top-tier text and image processing, and strong database performance, handling 87.47 million Redis SET operations per second. This profile makes the server highly efficient for in-memory databases, enterprise software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
